spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Three Foundational Truths

**¶2:** Three foundational truths, which exist from eternity, were ordained by the Divine itself. They were established in the external degrees of the mind — in the outermost planes where spiritual life takes fixed form.

**¶3:** The first foundational truth is the [GAP-1] sustaining power of divine wisdom made manifest — the Divine Human in its fullness — which was called forth [GAP-2] by the divine mediating presence that communicates celestial things to lower degrees. The Divine established this truth in a specific degree of spiritual life; [GAP-3] it extended its foundation from the lowest natural plane upward to the celestial. It sustained the whole order of spiritual states, and became the primary supporting truth among all [its] powers. In its confirmation it has been made upright and immovable, and has secured every reality both interior and exterior.

**¶4:** [GAP-4] The second great and glorious foundational truth is the regenerated natural mind illuminated by wisdom, which was established over the natural mind in its state of falsity from evil. It has broken the bonds of the five sensory faculties through which spiritual death enters. It has confirmed the dominion of truth, with absolute confirmation, over and beyond the mind's state of falsity. It has subdued, destroyed, and rendered powerless the deepest origin of spiritual death.

**¶5:** [GAP-5] The third foundational truth is the divine perception, which proceeded from Divine Truth itself in its glory. It has been established, with an unchangeable confirmation, to eternity.

**¶6:** [GAP-6] These are the three foundational truths, which have come forth in absolute certainty, into three exalted and sacred degrees of the mind. They were ordained and distributed across three essential planes of these same spiritual states. They were confirmed according to the will of the Divine itself.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Three great rocks, which exist, were appointed by the greatness. They were set in these outer worlds.

So, the first rock is the [Pillar] of Glory, the Perfect Man, which was summoned [by the] glorious Ambassador. He set it in this zone; [and he] brought forth its base (?) from the earth to heaven. It bore up under the [en]tire uni[verse], and became first of all the weight-carriers in [it]s powers. In its firmness it has been set upright, and has made fast every [t]hing above and below.

[The] second great and glorious rock is the new earth of light, which was set upon the earth of Darkness. It has squashed the fastenings of the five storehouses of death. It has established firmness, with great firmness, over and beyond the earth of Darkness. It has flattened, crushed and fixed the root of death.
[The] third rock is the great thought, which was summoned from Jesus, the glorious one. It has stood firm, with a true fixity, for ever.

[These] are the three great rocks, they that have come forth in great confidence, in three great and honoured places. They were appointed and distributed in three great places of these [self]same worlds. They were made fast according to the will of the greatness.

fills.explanation: The "Pillar of Glory" is the established Manichaean cosmological term (Syriac: *Esṭūnā d-Šubḥā*) for the cosmic sustaining column; it corresponds precisely to the spiritual reading's "sustaining power of divine wisdom made manifest," and is the standard term in the Kephalaia's own register.

The passive construction "was summoned by the glorious Ambassador" requires this preposition-article pair, and the spiritual reading confirms the agent is "the divine mediating presence" — i.e. the Ambassador, requiring "by the" to introduce him.

The spiritual reading shows continuous action by the same divine agent — "The Divine established this truth... it extended its foundation" — requiring a simple conjunctive transition "and he" to link the two clauses describing the Pillar's establishment and extension.

The definite article "The" opens the paragraph on the second rock, following the same structural pattern as the enumeration throughout the chapter, confirmed by the spiritual reading's "The second great and glorious foundational truth."

The definite article "The" opens the paragraph on the third rock, maintaining the parallel enumeration pattern established in ¶3 and ¶4, confirmed by the spiritual reading's "The third foundational truth."

The demonstrative pronoun "These" opens the concluding summary paragraph, pointing back to the three rocks just enumerated; this matches both the Kephalaia's standard recapitulation formula and the spiritual reading's "These are the three foundational truths."
